about_the_game:
ENLIST TODAY
Our Galaxy is under threat! In a cataclysmic uprising, the Harbingers have unleashed their wrath, ravaging countless worlds in a relentless bid for supremacy. Stand against the tide of destruction and fight for the fate of the Galaxy.

LEAD
Climb the ranks of 'The Lunar Corps'. Lead your fellow comrades into the face of battle and become the leader the Corps needs.

LIBERATE
Defend our planets and moons from the forces of evil. Bring justice to all those who have fallen.

UPGRADE
Customize your character, choose your weapons and upgrade your abilities.


MATURE CONTENT
This game may contain content that is not suitable for all ages or for viewing in the workplace, including frequent violence, gore, and general mature themes.

short_description: The Harbingers have begun their relentless harvest, and entire civilizations are crumbling one by one. The galaxy trembles on the brink of annihilation. The Lunar Corps is our last line of defense, so rally your forces and reclaim our galaxy.
